item.title: Aswan raises Abu Simbel entry fee for foreigners
item.dc:creator: Egypt Independent
item.description:
The Aswan Governorate’s Executive Council, led by Governor Amr Lashin, approved raising the local fee on Abu Simbel Temple tickets for non-Egyptian visitors from two LE to LE70. Governor Lashin framed the adjustment as a push to capture better economic value from Aswan’s world-famous antiquities and tourism draw, channeling fresh local funds into municipal upgrades …
